name: Pulse
tagline: Ready-made website for personal trainers and dietitians
description: Pulse is a website template for personal trainers, dietitians and small training studios, with a dark hero where an outlined headline word runs across a training photo, a slowly moving ticker of services with prices, a weekly schedule where each slot shows its length as a bar and a chosen time goes straight into the booking form, three packages laid out week by week, a stack of client stories, a two-person team section and a first session form with goal buttons. Graphite with a single orange accent and Archivo Black headings give the website a bold, focused character. Replace the copy, prices, schedule, photos, stories and legal pages with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with an outlined headline word running across the training photo
Slowly moving service ticker with prices that pauses on hover and focus
Weekly schedule from Monday to Saturday with session length bars and booked slots
Choosing a free slot fills in the day, time and session type in the booking form
Day switcher with one day's list of times on mobile
Three packages laid out week by week, with sessions and contact between sessions
Stack of client stories with arrows, each with a starting point and what changed in the week
Services page with a comparison table of eight formats, payment terms and a guide to choosing
Three service pages: personal training with a minute-by-minute first session, online training and nutrition
Transformations page with full stories and a weekly plan for each
First session form with goal and experience buttons and three short answers with FAQPage structured data
Polish and English versions, desktop, tablet and mobile layouts
